text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While thinking over our training
regimen...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Let's go! I'm here to train till I drop!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Oh, you're right. But I think we can
get
started anyway.
choice_data_list: まだトレーニング時間じゃないぞ？
まだトレーニング時間じゃないよ？
choice_data_list_en: It's not training time yet, you know?
It's not training time yet, you know?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's strange seeing Seiun Sky take her
training this
seriously since she's usually
the type to slack off.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: What's up? You're making a funny face.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Aha, I got it. You figured I was gonna
skip again,
huh?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, too bad. Yep, I just couldn't come
up with a
good plan for playing hooky
today.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Might be 'cause I'm feeling all sluggish. The ideas just weren't coming. Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If she's too exhausted to come up with a
plan to
skip training, it might be time to
adjust her
schedule so she can have a
break.
